title: The Sword Coast — a living, hand-inked map
excerpt: A 3D tabletop map where every mark is drawn by code: a simulated dip pen, watercolour washes, lettering written stroke by stroke. Weather drifts across it and the day turns. Rust → WebAssembly, hand-written WebGL2.
